planets.name: HD 89345 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 89345 with a 11.8-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: HD 89345 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 89345. Its orbit and size follow Yu et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: HD 89345 b
quotes.card: HD 89345 b is a Neptune-like exoplanet that orbits a G-type star.
